New Course with LandingAI: Document AI: From OCR to Agentic Doc Extraction
View in browser

Was this email forwarded to you? Subscribe here

Dear Daniel, 

 

We just launched a new short course, Document AI: From OCR to Agentic Doc Extraction, built in collaboration with LandingAI.

 

This course shows how to build agentic document processing pipelines that extract structured data from PDFs and images while preserving layout, reading order, tables, charts, and forms.

 

Much of the world’s data lives in documents. While OCR (optical character recognition) can extract text, it often loses visual structure and context, especially in complex layouts. This course demonstrates how to go beyond OCR using Agentic Document Extraction (ADE), LandingAI’s framework for treating documents as visual objects and grounding extracted fields to specific regions on the page.

Enroll Now

In this course, you’ll learn to:

  • Understand the limitations of OCR and why layout matters
  • Use agentic workflows to parse tables, charts, and multi-column documents
  • Extract structured outputs like Markdown and JSON with visual grounding
  • Build and deploy production-ready document pipelines on AWS

The course is taught by David Park, Senior Director of Applied AI at LandingAI, and Andrea Kropp, Applied AI Engineer at LandingAI.

Enroll Now

Keep learning,
